text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a guard for the Far Go Traders.
source_text: You see a guard for the Far Go Traders.

text: Those damn Water Merchants are ripp'n us all off.
source_text: Those damn Water Merchants are ripp'n us all off.

text: Be sure to pay the FLC on time, they're a deadly lot.
source_text: Be sure to pay the FLC on time, they're a deadly lot.

text: You'll want to talk to Rutger.
source_text: You'll want to talk to Rutger.

text: Far Go Traders are the best.
source_text: Far Go Traders are the best.

text: The Crimson Caravan are a bunch of idiots and lunatics.
source_text: The Crimson Caravan are a bunch of idiots and lunatics.

text: Hmm, I've a craving for some iguana on a stick.
source_text: Hmm, I've a craving for some iguana on a stick.

text: Who the hell is stealing our caravans?
source_text: Who the hell is stealing our caravans?

text: My brother was on the last caravan that disappeared.
source_text: My brother was on the last caravan that disappeared.

text: Those water misers are responsible, I know it.
source_text: Those water misers are responsible, I know it.

text: Mutants took the caravans I hear. Terrible thing.
source_text: Mutants took the caravans I hear. Terrible thing.

text: Heard you say some Mutants.  Hope you made'em pay.
source_text: Heard you say some Mutants.  Hope you made'em pay.

text: I thought the Death Claw was responsible, damn mutants.
source_text: I thought the Death Claw was responsible, damn mutants.

text: We're closed. Come back in the morning.
source_text: We're closed. Come back in the morning.

text: Hey, this isn't the Falcon. Get the hell out.
source_text: Hey, this isn't the Falcon. Get the hell out.

text: What are you? Some kind of a Skag? Get the hell out.
source_text: What are you? Some kind of a Skag? Get the hell out.

text: Beat it!
source_text: Beat it!

text: We're only open during the day.
source_text: We're only open during the day.

text: Are you on drugs? Get lost.
source_text: Are you on drugs? Get lost.

text: You need to come back in the morning.
source_text: You need to come back in the morning.

text: 你看到一个远行商队的保镖。
source_text: 你看到一个远行商队的保镖。

text: 那些该死的水商人把我们全骗了。
source_text: 那些该死的水商人把我们全骗了。

text: 要保证准时付钱给友好信贷公司，否则他们会要我们的命。
source_text: 要保证准时付钱给友好信贷公司，否则他们会要我们的命。

text: 你去和罗格尔谈谈把。
source_text: 你去和罗格尔谈谈把。

text: 远行商队是最好的商队。
source_text: 远行商队是最好的商队。

text: 深红商队那群白痴不是疯子就是傻子。
source_text: 深红商队那群白痴不是疯子就是傻子。

text: 哎，我好想要串烤大蜥蜴。
source_text: 哎，我好想要串烤大蜥蜴。

text: 哪个该死的偷了我们的商队？
source_text: 哪个该死的偷了我们的商队？

text: 我兄弟在上次那个失踪的商队里。
source_text: 我兄弟在上次那个失踪的商队里。

text: 我认为，那些守水的吝啬鬼该对这事儿负责。
source_text: 我认为，那些守水的吝啬鬼该对这事儿负责。

text: 我听说是变种人干的，真可怕。
source_text: 我听说是变种人干的，真可怕。

text: 听你说是一些变种人。希望你能让他们血债血还。
source_text: 听你说是一些变种人。希望你能让他们血债血还。

text: 我认为死亡爪该负主要责任，该死的变种人。
source_text: 我认为死亡爪该负主要责任，该死的变种人。

text: 我们关门了。早上再来把。
source_text: 我们关门了。早上再来把。

text: 嘿，这不是猎鹰。滚到地狱去吧。
source_text: 嘿，这不是猎鹰。滚到地狱去吧。

text: 你算老几？什么垃圾货色？滚蛋……
source_text: 你算老几？什么垃圾货色？滚蛋……

text: 走开！
source_text: 走开！

text: 我们只在白天开放。
source_text: 我们只在白天开放。

text: 你带了毒品了？滚开！
source_text: 你带了毒品了？滚开！

text: 你只能等早上回来。
source_text: 你只能等早上回来。
